title: Web panel choices
decision: The new screens (staff, ownership transfer, activity log, shop deletion, totals) are in the panel only and the Mini App is unchanged; the CSRF token is kept in memory only, so reloading the page asks for sign-in again; tables are not sortable because the API has no sort parameter; staff are shown by role and the end of their membership identifier because the API gives no names; panel texts are in a catalog of their own
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 40
rationale: Keeping the token out of storage is the safer default, and the API offers no way to get it again for a session that already exists
